brainlife.readme:
## BIDS Extension Proposal 5 (BEP005)

https://docs.google.com/document/d/15tnn5F10KpgHypaQJNNGiNKsni9035GtDqJzWqkkP6c/edit

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.perf.ASL.json

files.desc: ASL time series (label, control, M0 or derived volumes).
aslcontext.tsv: volume type of each ASL volume.

A M0 image is a calibration or reference image, used to estimate the M0 of blood. It is usually weighted toward the M0 of tissue, and is required especially when ASL is acquired with background suppression and/or pre-saturation pulses.

It is recommended to specify as much labeling information as possible for quality control, such as: a description of the location of the labeling slab, the labeling slab orientation, labeling slab distance and labeling slab thickness, and the labeling efficiency. Different approaches can be utilized for labeling positioning, depending on the preference of the researcher, as well as the flexibility of the sequence to manually optimize the labeling position. Therefore, an anonymized screenshot of the planning of the labeling plane for each session, saved as *_asllabeling.jpg, can clarify exact positioning and is recommended.

identifying_risks: JSON metadata may hold acquisition dates, institution or device serials
Scanner screenshots (asllabeling.jpg) can show names or dates
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level neurodata linkable through a code; no recognisable face at typical resolution.
sharing_cautions: Check that the labeling screenshot is anonymized
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if metadata keeps acquisition dates or device serials
Tier 3 if the labeling screenshot shows patient names or dates
